name: Obsessive Love
overview: Scripture reveals that obsessive love can deeply influence human behavior, as seen in Jacob’s unwavering commitment to Rachel, serving seven years because of his intense affection (Genesis 29:18, 20). However, the Bible also warns believers to guard their hearts diligently, recognizing that unchecked desires and jealousy can lead to destructive consequences (Proverbs 4:23; 6:25, 34). This balance calls Christians to love rightly, avoiding the pitfalls of passionate obsession that can cloud judgment and provoke wrath.
